description: Keep passwords, API keys and personal data out of your source files, so AI coding agents like Copilot, Claude Code and Cursor never see them. Secrets live in an encrypted vault and reach your program only after your approval.
capabilities.untrusted: SealBox runs a local command-line engine, which can come from the workspace's .venv. Trust the folder to enable it.
command.sealFile: Move This File's Secrets to the Vault
command.sealProject: Move All Project Secrets to the Vault
command.reveal: Show a Value from the Vault
command.expose: Pass Redacted Data to the Program at Run Time
command.manualHelp: How Do I Fix a Secret That Must Be Moved by Hand?
command.history: Scan Git History for Exposed Secrets
command.hookInstall: Install Commit Hook (Keep Vault Values out of Commits)
config.executable: Path to the `sealbox` engine. When empty, the project's `.venv` is searched first, then `PATH`.
config.checkOnSave: Check files for exposed secrets when they are opened or saved.
walkthrough.title: Get Started with SealBox
walkthrough.description: Move your secrets out of your files in five minutes, so AI coding agents never see them.
walkthrough.install.title: Install the engine
walkthrough.install.description:
SealBox uses a small Python command-line engine (Python 3.12+). Install it with `pipx install sealbox`, then check it here.
[Check Installation](command:sealbox.checkInstallation)
walkthrough.scan.title: Scan your project
walkthrough.scan.description:
Find passwords, API keys, tokens and personal data that are sitting in plain text on disk.
[Scan Project](command:sealbox.checkProject)
walkthrough.seal.title: Move secrets to the vault
walkthrough.seal.description:
SealBox moves each secret into an encrypted vault and rewrites the code to read an environment variable instead.
[Move Secrets to Vault](command:sealbox.sealProject)
walkthrough.run.title: Run with Vault
walkthrough.run.description:
Start your program through SealBox. After you approve, secrets are passed as environment variables and hidden in the output.
[Run with Vault](command:sealbox.exec)
walkthrough.recovery.title: Create a recovery code
walkthrough.recovery.description:
If the vault key is ever lost (new computer, OS reset), this one-time code brings your vaults back.
[Create Recovery Code](command:sealbox.recoverySetup)
